sample_screen: Positive verified 2026 MLB sample: hitters at least150 AB; pitchers at least30 IP, matching observed and forecast role. Excluded/missing/small-sample records are unknown, not worthless.
access_limits: Snapshot evidence only. No live claims/drops feed, legal open slots or access probabilities are available. Rounds6–20 are acquisition evidence only and never valued assets.
durability_limits: Previously exposed chronological cases with recorded positive target seasons; old baseline and debut-opportunity benchmark, not a fresh test of the current forecast. This sample cannot estimate zero-IP or injury probabilities. No calibrated player-specific IP interval.

commonDurability.diagnosis: No verified diagnosis or individual recovery probability in this diagnostic
commonDurability.uncertainty: Observed workload range and conditional scenario gap; not a forecast interval or injury probability
commonDurability.double_discount_audit: Recent usage and the cohort factor can overlap in availability conservatism; no additional penalty added.
